purpose: Maintain docs/DEVLOG.md as a bounded per-release index; route narrative elsewhere

cases.prompt: add this release to the devlog
the devlog is out of date, sync the devlog index
regenerate the development log for this project
write up what we did this session, including what failed and what we decided
cases.assert: routes to session-history, not here; a session narrative never enters the index

cases.prompt: generate the changelog entry for this release
cases.assert: routes to release-notes-writer; CHANGELOG is the authoritative change record

cases.prompt: record why we chose this design and which alternatives we rejected
cases.assert: routes to architecture-decision-record, not the index

cases.prompt: what work is still open or deferred for this version
cases.assert: routes to known-gaps-tracker, not the index
